fields.personality: John Kelly devoted his life to serving his country as a soldier or in other similar capacities, to the point of becoming one the best officers of his time. Kelly had the strategic mindset of an officer, having served as a Colonel in the U.S. Army, later in the Marine Corps, but was proven inadequate in the NYPD. Kelly was perceived as brutal, have no compunction about killing even a helpless prisoner and was not beyond torturing a person. Honoring his nickname, he was unwilling to stop attacks or give up a perceived advantage, enjoying conflict by the sake of conflict. Kelly was, however, not the bully that Michael Collins, a pacifist, initially believed Kelly to be: Kelly did not use lethal force except on confirmed enemies he considered irredeemable, and frequently controlled the amount of violence to just keep people at bay, such as soldiers who were not his enemies. Still, he was willing to accept collateral damage, including civilian casualties, when he believed the alternative was even worse. Kelly rarely, if ever, lost a fight, but he perceived that several wars he was involved in had been lost, due to the higher command taking decisions that made an American victory unfeasible. Kelly had constant problems with bureaucratic authority, and was also unable to save his own marriage: His wife Karen divorced him, thinking that he was not the right influence for their young daughter; and Kelly let them go, never trying to contact them again. His failed family life, combined with his willingness to accept any necessary sacrifice for the cause, especially sacrifices he himself was to made, caused Kelly to volunteered to have his brain transplanted to a cyborg body in an irreversible process. Kelly had been convinced that he would stop being human, but he would also become an invincible weapon, and if something could shake Kelly's mind was the idea of being defeated himself. Once transformed into an artificial intelligence, Kelly was shaken by the possibility of him not being really John Kelly, but only a deranged software that believed to be him. Within Siege's cyborg body, Kelly had no tactile sensation, which was a problem for him because he could not feel the adrenaline rush even in combat. He occasionally tried to find a way to overcome this problem, but was unwilling to make moral sacrifices for it. Considering life as Siege better than life as a software, Kelly refused to give up his body, and the idea of him being disassembled for study was triggering for him. Occasionally, Siege resorted to humor while in a fight, which can be considered a mechanism to cope with his situation, and once he was found speaking out loud for himself; Michael Collins also tended to speak like that, as his onboard computer communicated to him in what he perceived as a spoken voice, even if the computer did not require Collins to answer him out loud. Through his life, Kelly made few friends, except maybe among fellow officers. His trust on both his wife Karen and Cybertek head Harlan Ryker was in time shattered. Kelly was, or believed to be, in good terms with a number of people he had worked with, including Coldblood-7, Daredevil, Nick Fury, Silver Sable, Godwulf, and especially Michael Collins, his successor in Deathlok's body. Their relationship was frequently strained when Collins repeatedly thought Kelly was a threat, but they literally shared memories (as each of them had access to the other's recollections), leading to them cooperating and spending free time together.
abilities: John Kelly had extensive combat training both in the military and in the police, that turned him into a very good hand-to-hand fighter. He was also a good , and considered one of the best soldiers in his country.
equipment: Body Suit: Siege wore a woven metal-mesh body suit of high durability.
weapons: After joining Command, Siege wielded a two-hand gun. This weapon was never seen in use, so it is unclear what it did, or why Siege was no longer using his built-in plasma cannon and gatling gun.
fields.notes: Siege's profile, reorders some events in comics, so that Deathlok's encounter with Nightmare (in 9) takes place after his encounters with High-Tech (in ) and with Biohazard (in -14). It is also the only source suggesting that Kelly was controlling the Deathlok cyborg at that point; the behavior that Deathlok showed in #9 was not all the behavior shown by Kelly in his other appearances nor was identified as such, and seemed more like the onboard computer reacting to Nightmare's input. The same profile says that Siege saved an old US Air Force friend in Iraq. However, the story in shows how Siege's old friend Danny dies in the field, Siege being unable to save him. The story also describes Danny as "an old marine buddy", not USAF. In , we see Siege flying over Atlas Mountains in Northwest Africa, from his previous location in Iraq (in ) to his destination in Eastern European country Transia (in ), following the Cyberwarriors. Geographically, it makes no sense to reach the Atlas Mountains, as it would require a very big detour, even if Siege had a reason to avoid flying over Turkey.
fields.trivia: thumb|right|Deathlok's face was initially a decomposed version of Kelly's face (left), but nanomachines later modified it using Michael Collins' DNA to make it look more like Collins' face (right). Deathlok's body includes nanotechnology programmed to replace and repair the organic cells based on instructions where they receive information from the brain's DNA. After Kelly's brain was replaced with Collins', the nanotech assemblers and replicators have altered Deathlok's face and possibly body, initially similar to John Kelly's, to be more similar to Michael Collins'. Kelly has no criminal record. Kelly is implied to be a republican.

john keystone.name: John Keystone
john keystone.origin: John Keystone was cheated out of his house by his brother, Tom. In revenge, he murdered his brother, and swore to prevent the house from being sold to anyone else. Over the next thirty years, he murdered anyone who slept in his bed, and the house gained a reputation for being haunted. Finally, while posing as real estate agent 'Paul Harris', he murdered the property's housekeeper, Jeb Treble, and made it look like he himself had narrowly escaped the vengeance of the 'ghost'. Having left no physical evidence of his crimes, Keystone was confident the house would now never be sold and would forever remain his.

john kowalski.name: John Kowalski
john kowalski.origin: John Kowalski was a sergeant in the United States Marine Corps and received a Medal of Honor for his service. He joined the Marines in 1919. In 1924, he was stationed in Ch'ang-Sha, China, where he met Tsuin Hanneford, the half-Chinese daughter of Dr. Michael Hanneford, and fell in love with her. Her brother Chou disapproved of the relationship and had Kowalski severely beaten. When the Chinese nationalists moved in on Ch'ang-Sha, Kowalski was ordered to evacuate Hanneford, but Chou wanted to join the nationalists and caused a firefight with the American troops. During the fight, Kowalski shot Chou, which caused Tsuin to hate him. Unknown to him, she was pregnant with his child. In 1937, he was charged with treason for unrevealed reasons and dishonourably discharged, as well as deported to Poland. Just before the outbreak of World War II, John was approached by Dr. Eric Ostergan, a German with the Anti-Hitler underground. His organization had learned of Hitler's plans to invade Poland, and Ostergan asked Kowalski for help in contacting the American government. Kowalski didn't care and turned him down, and when Ostergan was killed during the invasion, he cursed Kowalski with his dying breath. When Kowalski was killed shortly thereafter during a fight with a scavenger, he became an agent of Death, possessing recently deceased people and atoning for his sins by helping other people escape the horrors of war. In 1940, while possessing the body of japanese Colonel Sessue Takeda, he met Tsuin again and realized they had a son. He helped both of them escape the Japanese Army. Kowalski reappeared in Florida, stopping a group of bikers from attacking Andrew Kale until he could be rescued by the Man-Thing. Kowalski walked with Andrew to the Kale farmhouse, where he spoke briefly with Barbara Bannister and Jennifer Kale before the bikers returned and attacked the farmhouse, first going after Man-Thing with molotov cocktails before forcing Andrew to fight their leader. Man-Thing recovered in time to drive most of the bikers off, before Andrew was shot by their leader. Kowalski intervened, saying that the fight was over, before the biker shot him numerous times to no effect. Kowalski then killed the biker, and explained that he was a personification of Death. Kowalski made a deal with Barbara, offering to help her rescue her lover John Daltry, in exchange for her joining him as an agent of Death. She agreed, and was granted powers. Kowalski transported Barbara, Jennifer, and Man-Thing to the mystic realm where John Daltry was keeping prisoners, including Doctor Strange, for Thog. After Thog was defeated and the prisoners released, Strange condemned Kowalski for forcing Barbara into the deal, saying that his punishment hasn't taught him anything. Kowalski accepted the criticism, with the excuse that he did it because he had been alone for too long, and released Barbara from the vow of becoming an agent of Death. Kowalski met and fell in love with Melinda Morrison, she discovered his status as an agent of death after a fatal car accident and ran away from him, with Kowalski following her. Melinda sought help from the Scarlet Witch, who nearly took John's spot as death, Melinda admitted to feeling true love for him and the conflict stopped.

john laviano.name: John Laviano
john laviano.origin: John Laviano was one of the NYPD detectives who investigated the murder of Frank Castle's family in Central Park. He helped Frank identify the killers after his recovery, although his supervisor, captain Howard Furniss, prohibited him to go on with the inquiry because the mobsters responsible for the massacre, the Costa mob, had all alibis (implying they had police connections in the top hierarchy of the department). Laviano and his partner, Stan Witts, later received reports of several assaults on the Costas' network, which they accepted to deal with while, in reality, they threw away the dossier in retaliation for the police cover-up of the Central Park massacre. Laviano was finally contacted by Frank Castle, now turned into the Punisher, who was behind the attacks all along, and felt compelled to reveal him the identity of Billy Russo, the hitman the Costas had used to kill Frank's former ally and Daily Bugle reporter: Mike McTeer. Years later, Laviano, now retired, met with Peter Parker to discuss the Punisher. Laviano expressed distaste for most vigilantes, like Spider-Man, but praised the Punisher, with his veneration of Castle's lethal one-man war on crime unsettling Parker.
abilities: Police training Investigation

john lennon skrull.name: John Lennon (Skrull)
john lennon skrull.origin: ===Origin=== thumb|left|200px John Lennon was originally a member of the Skrull Beatles, a group of Skrulls who took on the appearances of the original Beatles, with John taking the form of John Lennon. The faux-Beatles were intended to take the place of the real Beatles, and use their positions to launch an early version of the Secret Invasion. John, however, thought the Skrull Beatles could do more than an alien invasion, and convinced their bosses to give them free reign. Much like the real Beatles, the Skrull Beatles eventually found their interests leading in different directions, leading to the band's break-up. John embarked on a relationship with Captain Boko of the Free Kree Liberation Army. ===MI13=== Some time after the band broke up, John came to work for the British intelligence agency MI13. In his missions with Pete Wisdom's initial MI13 team, he generally took background roles. When assaulting a fairy hillfort in Otherworld, he transformed into Merlyn, attempting to command the Fairies to do his bidding, but was interrupted by Tink taking the opportunity to assault the Fairies. When Pantagruel awoke, he helped save citizens and briefly pondered giving "Skrull Paul a call" but ultimately decided that he wouldn't. When Y Ddraig Goch, the Welsh Dragon, battled Shang-Chi he, along with most citizens of the Welsh town they were in, had their energy absorbed by the dragon, and were left sleeping during the battle. And when a myriad of extra-dimensional Jack the Rippers were unleashed on London, John found himself up against an ape-Ripper. Eventually, when Maureen Raven became a conduit for an extra-dimensional Martian invasion, John called up the rest of the Skrull Beatles and the foursome helped several UK-based heroes defend Britain from the Martian invasion. As of the Secret Invasion, John had been incarcerated in a containment cell in Shoreditch by orders of a Skrull disguised as Joint Intelligence Committee director Mortimer Grimsdale, but was saved by Pete Wisdom just in time to join him, Captain Britain and Spitfire in their efforts of trying to stop the Skrulls from robbing Avalon itself of all magic, as merely another power to be seized by the intergalactic empire. They managed to gather most of the magical artifacts present there, except for Excalibur, which Pete, John, and Spitfire were to take away and had to guard from the massive wave of Skrulls coming after them, and combine them to turn their coordinator into a Chimera-like master magic user (even with Dr. Strange's powers among others). Even though Merlin had resurrected Captain Britain later (who died stopping a missile headed to the gates of Avalon), he could not stop John, Spitfire, Pete, and Tink from being captured by the Skrull force. John did not live long enough to see the Skrull invasion to the British Isles and the Otherworld come to an abrupt end: he was killed by the head operative after mocking them, with a point blank shot to his forehead.

john lester.name: John Lester
john lester.origin: Mark Todd does on vacation making a stop in Red Valley where he hopes to visit his fathers friend Old Man Lester. Inquiring where Lester lives, he learns from a hotel owner that the old man has become a recluse who turns away visitors. Undaunted, Todd decides to pay a visit and gets the door slammed in his face. When Old Man Lester tries to shoot him, Mark decides to investigate things further as the Blazing Skull. As it turns out, Lester is plotting to rob the city bank by way of travelling through an abandoned mine. His robbery goes off without a hitch, and he fatally shoots a security guard. The guard tells the authorities that Lester made the robbery before dying. While Lester returns home with his loot, the Blazing Skull arrives and attempts to fight him and his gang of thugs. The Skull is knocked out and tossed in a room with... Old Man Lester? As it turns out Lester was knocked out and is being impersonated by mobster Killer Brogan. With the authorities on their way to arrest Lester, Brogan removes his mask and enters the room to try and kill the Blazing Skull. The hero easily trounces Brogan and his men and reveals the truth to the authorities. Brogan manages to escape capture and rushes into the mine. Fighting Brogan in the mine shaft causes a cave in that kills Brogan. Later, back in his civilian identity, Mark Todd pays a visit to the real Lester.

john lindsay.name: John Lindsay
john lindsay.origin: Lindsay was mayor of New York City when the Zodiac Cartel briefly took over Manhattan. He was freed upon the Zodiac's defeat at the hands of the Avengers and Daredevil. He was later controlled by the Over-Mind, and ordered the Fantastic Four arrested to be arrested by the NYPD. He was later freed from the Over-Mind's control when the villain was later banished to the Microverse. Lindsay appeared during Foggy Nelson's tenure as District Attorney of New York, appearing in a public service announcement abd telling New Yorkers to assist the authorities in stopping a mobster called Crime-Wave. When an accountant from the town hall was murdered by an almost-intelligent tiger while working late, the Mayor -portrayed as Lindsay- was informed. The Mayor then confirmed the credibility of the witnesses and hired super-powered private eye Luke Cage -to avoid investigations by people like the Avengers who would not answer to law enforcement agencies- and because he wanted his agent to take orders. Cage found and neutralized the guilty party, an Alejandro Cortez, and collected the town's payment.

john lissom.name: John Lissom
john lissom.origin: The man who came to be known as the Creeper was a spy for the Nazis during World War II. At sometime during the war he was personally selected by Adolf Hitler himself to go to America to cause as much havoc as possible. Upon arriving in the United States he gathered a gang and attempted to break into an US military arsenal but was captured by Captain America and Bucky and sent to jail. Shortly after his incarceration, the Creeper broke out of prison and vowed revenge against Captain America for his defeat. thumb|left|109px|Posing as Ambassador Lissom By December of 1942, the Creeper used his espionage skills (under the name Lissom) to become the American Ambassador to the nation of Alslavia, the last of the European countries to remain neutral during the war. There he pleaded to King Dane to ally himself with the United States and the Allied Forces, debated against a Nazi operative. Eventually, King Dane decided to side with the Allies and gave Lissom a ring studded with three rubies as a present that he must wear during the signing of the treaty documents. Knowing that should the ring go missing it would sour relations between Alslavia and the Untied States, Lissom -- as the Creeper -- stole the ruby and mocked the Untied States government, openly challenging Captain America to try and recover the ring before the deadline to sign the treaty passed. Captain America took up the challenge and when the Creeper's men attempted to rob the U.S.O. headquarters, they were led right to the Creeper's lair. There the heroes beat the Creeper's men into submission and found only one of the 3 rubies, learning that the Creeper had hidden them in different locations. Tracking the Creeper down to his other hideout, Captain America and Bucky once more beat his men and recovered the second ruby. There they were caught at gunpoint by the Creeper who forced them into the dungeon of his lair and were shackled to the walls. When the Creeper attempted to brand Captain America with a hot iron, the hero kicked him in the face. The Creeper then decided to leave the heroes locked in his dungeon while he went the television station where the signing was taking place to watch the historical blunder he helped orchestrate. Captain America managed to break free and with time running out sneaked out of the Creeper's hideout without Bucky. He confronted the Creeper at the television station and beat him into submission, recovering the three ruby's and revealing him to be none other than Lissom himself. Rushing back to the spies hideout, Captain America rescued Bucky and explained the whole ordeal. In the aftermath of the crisis, the treaty between Alslavia and the Allied Forces was signed by President Roosevelt who wore the restored ruby ring. The Creeper's subsequent fate is unknown.
weapons: The Creeper wielded a pistol and used a branding iron to torture his enemies.

john litch.name: John Litch
john litch.origin: Branch Vegger and his men are carrying a stage coach full of silver when they are held up by two masked individuals who steal the coach and flee the scene. Happening by is the Black Rider who sees the robbery and goes after the robbers unaware that Branch and his men find a great deal of humour that the Black Rider is helping them. The Black Rider stops the coach and the thieves surrender, revealing themselves to be John Litch and his daughter Lee. Litch explains that he found the silver mine for which the stolen silver came from. However after his discovery he soon caught Branch Vegger and his men snooping on his property and forced them to flee. However the next day the claims office burned down destroying all the paperwork for his claim and Litch soon found himself thrown off his own stake when Branch returned with new papers naming him the owner of the silver. Consumed by hatred ever since being robbed of his fortune, Litch and his daughter plotted the robbery to get what is rightfully theirs back. After hearing the story, the Black Rider tells Litch that he has to return the stolen silver because he cannot prove that Vegger swindled him out of the mine stake, but promises to try and prove that Vegger owns the mine illegally. The Black Rider then returns the coach to Vegger and his men who laugh over their victory. After the Black Rider unearthed Vegger's affair and his death, the mine is turned back over to Litch and his daughter who thank the Black Rider for his help.

john lopez.name: John Lopez
john lopez.origin: ===Origin=== John Lopez was born in Bronx. As a kid he was often taken to Yankee Stadium by his father to watch games. However, his father was an addict and for ten years was either in rehab or in jail. Lopez was a chronic child bed-wetter, until he discovered that he was a mutant capable to generate a spurt of water from his body when he touched anything. ===X-Statix=== Years later, John was approached by Malcolm Colcord, who offered to help him change his life. John refused at first, because the offer was fishy, but Colcord pinpointed that John was a loser all his life, he have no friends or family, works on a boring job and his power is almost useless, so he had nothing to lose. Accepting the offer, John underwent a process that greatly enhanced his power and allowed him to transform into water and control it. To test his new power, Colcord summoned Eric Moreels, and ordered John to try to control the water in Moreels' body. John did, and the water started to boil, despite Moreels' pleas for mercy John hadn't stopped until Moreels exploded. John wanted to try his luck at an audition to join the new media-savvy X-Force team. Taking on the codename Wash-Out, John competed in a contest and defeated Lightning Bug, but in the end he was not recruited. ===Weapon X=== thumb|left|The side-effects Soon after, John joined the Weapon X Program and changed name to Washout. He participated in their attack on the Zodiac to retrieve Madison Jeffries. Washout killed Capricorn and Pisces by drowning them. The team was next sent to interrogate associates of Sabretooth, who had stolen and hid important information from Weapon X. Washout fought with Avalanche and then interrogated him and Blob, but with no results. After several other missions Washout discovered that his skin was cracking and peeling off. Fellow Weapon X agent Brent Jackson revealed to him that the procedure that augmented John's powers had a side-effect; he was dehydrating after each usage of powers and would die soon. Feeling betrayed by Director Colcord, Washout joined Brent Jackson's group in a conspiracy against the Director and started to work with Cable's Underground movement. Washout helped the Underground infiltrate the Weapon X compound by temporarily shutting down the power. At the same time he attacked and attempted to kill the Director. He caused the water within the Director's body to boil, but the side effects from his powers caused Washout to die before he could finish off the Director. Washout's remains were taken by Mister Sinister.

john lovejoy.name: John Lovejoy
john lovejoy.origin: John Lovejoy was a student at Randolph Tech. He assisted an unconscious Tad Sheen, the school janitor, by pouring cold water on his face. John attributed the accident that had stunned Tad to the experiment that Tad had done in the lab and the subsequent explosion that occurred. John then, after making sure that Tad was okay, advised him to give up the experiments that, in addition to potentially losing his job, there was also the risk that he could get hurt, not knowing that Tad had not been hurt in the accident in the laboratory but had traveled into the past and been hit in the head during a fight with the Indians.

john mack.name: John Mack
john mack.origin: “John Mack” was a false identity used by an unnamed professional assassin, later revealed to be a Mossad operative, hired to eliminate Dr. Morris Brattle to prevent him from repairing the Brattle Gun for Trafia. This information was later disclosed to the Punisher by Wild Rose. Having deduced that Brattle was being targeted, the Punisher intercepted him on the street and persuaded the scientist to exchange coat and hat, allowing Castle to impersonate him and draw out the would-be killer. john macomber.name: John Macomber
john macomber.origin: John Macomber was the patriarch of the Macomber family, which had become wealthy due to their successful coffin-crafting business. Unfortunately, they paid their workers a pittance while they lived opulently, which left the town of Macombersville and its citizens nearly destitute at all times. When he died, his body was collected by the town's funeral director Charles Beecher, who intended to charge the family a hefty fee for use of one of their own "deluxe model" coffins. However, Macomber had only fallen into a deep comatose state and revived at Beecher's funeral parlor. Refusing to be denied his fee, Beecher forced John Macomber back into his coffin and shut it closed. Sealed inside, Macomber could only pound against the lid until either a lack of air or the stress of attempting to free himself finally caused him to expire. Ironically, Beecher died alongside Macomber -- literally -- when he opened the coffin to examine the body, only to slip on a candle that had fallen on the floor earlier and fall in, the lid slamming shut behind him. When the pallbearers arrived, they heard Beecher pounding against the lid but, assuming that it was John Macomber still alive, decided to bury him anyway, having come to hate the Macomber family in general and their father in particular for his miserly ways.

john magnus.name: John Magnus
john magnus.species: Human Mutated into a Rat body
john magnus.origin: thumb|left|John Magnus Graverobber John Magnus has made a killing off the jewelery he takes from the recently deceased, even selling younger bodies off for medical research. However, his business has taken a hit as the cemetary rats often beat him to the bodies, pulling them right thru the coffin into a series of tunnels. Frustrated, John attempts to strip the jewelery off a corpse buried that morning. He pries open the coffin just in time to catch the rats pulling the body thru the bottom of the coffin. Not wanting to loss the profit, he grabs on to the corpse's ankles, but is dragged through the hole and underground. While fighting of the rats, the ground collapses on him, trapping him with the rats. John fights to free himself, fearful that the rats will eat him alive, however, through unrevealed circumstances, he is in fact transformed into a rat with a human head.

john martin.name: John Martin
john martin.origin: John "Machine Gun" Martin was a notorious mobster who earned his nom de guerre for his choice of weapon, the machine gun. Martin was locked away for his crimes in the early 1930s. Breaking out of prison he was on the run from the law, until Martin was abducted by a Skrull Slave-Master from the planet Kral IV. On Kral, the style, mannerisms, and speech of Martin so fascinated the Skrulls there they began adopting the culture, co-opted from footage they took of Earth as well as from Martin himself. Before his death, Machine Gun Martin had influenced the entire planet of Kral to adopt the esthetics of Martin's era. Kral's inhabitants even erected a statue of him in his memory. Martin's disappearance remained a mystery for years on Earth, although UFO sightings around the time of his disappearance added to the wild speculations of the time. His disappearance was later reported upon in a 1939 edition of the Daily Bugle. The fate of Machine Gun Martin was not learned until many decades later during the modern age, when the planet Kral was visited by members of the Fantastic Four. Martin's legacy endures to this very days with the majority of Skrulls on Kral IV still adopting the trappings of Machine Gun's era.
weapons: While on Earth, Machine Gun Martin used the very weapon that was his namesake.

john mcgurk.name: John McGurk
john mcgurk.origin: ===Origin and overview=== Long John McGurk was an alien cyborg pirate of an unknown race from an alternate dimension from Earth. He was the captain of a flying sky-galleon known as the T'ai Javinee. McGurk's crew routinely conducted raids against the noble floating city of Bel Amee Anora. One day, Long John McGurk discovered a strange passenger on his ship. A mutant from the planet Earth named Nightcrawler, and a small, purple dragon named Lockheed suddenly appeared on the deck of the T'ai Javinee. The pirates mistakenly believed Nightcrawler to be a member of a race of impish creatures known as Boggies. They further believed Lockheed to be a Frumious Bandersnatch. Captain McGurk ordered his men to apprehend the stowaways, and a brief scuffle ensued. However, a peace was soon established between the combatants, and Kurt was welcomed among them as an honorary part of the crew. As Nightcrawler possessed no means to return to his home dimension, he decided to make the best of his situation and eke out a life among the pirates. He even went so far as to teach them games of chance such as Poker. thumb|left After a week's worth of time though, Kurt found himself at odds with his new friends. The T'ai Javinee came upon the Royal Barge of Bel Amee Anora and opened fire upon it with their high-tech deck cannons. Although Kurt enjoyed McGurk’s hospitality, he could not allow them to attack an unarmed opponent. Nightcrawler took command of the T'ai Javinee's weapons and fired several shots into the ship's deck. Captain McGurk ordered his men to attack Nightcrawler, but the teleporting mutant easily evaded capture. Kurt and Lockheed escaped from the T'ai Javinee and boarded the Royal Barge. Captain McGurk ceased his attack against the barge, but followed it back to the floating city of Bel Amee Anora. He knew that Nightcrawler would be among them and was determined to get revenge for his betrayal. He instructed one of his female cohorts, Meg, to bait Kurt into a darkened alley. While Kurt attended to Meg's "needs", McGurk slugged him from behind. He then sold him to an evil sorcerer named Shagreen. McGurk later regretted the transaction, as Shagreen paid him in less than the agreed upon amount. He piloted the T'ai Javinee to Shagreen's fortress at L'un Dun-T'wn and released a volley of cannon fire. Nightcrawler escaped from the sorcerer’s clutches and made amends with Captain McGurk. Long John and he then worked together to bring Shagreen's citadel crumbling down. With the threat of the sorcerer extinguished, Long John McGurk bade goodbye to Nightcrawler and set sail for greater fortune. ==Crew of the T'ai Javinee== Blackknob Meg Slimey Spikenose and many other unnamed pirates
abilities: Long John McGurk was skilled in the arena of piracy and possessed charismatic command capabilities. He was likewise proficient with various high-tech firearms and siege weapons.
weapons: Long John McGurk used a highly advanced laser pistol, and occasionally carried a cutlass.

john moth.name: John Moth
john moth.origin: Learning that the company where the window washer who had accomplished the theft as the Human Fly was called the Hi-Low Window Washing Company, Captain America and Bucky rushed there and found that the company was owned by Hyram Heale. They found the office empty, but searching it they find a newspaper clipping about John Moth, a lighthouse keeper who has a stamp collection valued at $25,000. They rushed to the lighthouse where they caught the Human Fly as he tried to break in. A fight broke out, but the Human Fly found himself outmatched and attempted to flee. As he rushed down the lighthouse, he tripped over an alcove where food was stored, knocking over a barrel of molasses. The sticky liquid then got caught in the suction cups of his Human Fly costume, planting the villain to the ground. Captain America fell the Human Fly with a single punch and revealed him to be Hyram Heale and got the lighthouse keeper to call the authorities.

john myers.name: John Myers
john myers.origin: thumb|left John Myers was a recently-graduated unemployed teenager, who decided to go to the Hobgoblin's course to reinvent himself into a super hero, initially believing it was to become a super villain. Months later, he became one of Hobgoblin's Hob-Heroes, now known as the Missile Mate. However, when Phil Urich confronted Kingsley in his headquarters, Myers was convinced by Urich's claims that the Hobgoblin would soon abandon the heroes he had trained. Missile Mate went to Urich's headquarters and asked him to join him to be a supervillain. Urich was reluctant since he already had the loyalty of half the villians Kingsley abandoned after his inversion, but Myers soon showed him that he had also gathered to join his cause the other half of the villians. In order to be admitted into Goblin Nation, Myers had to kill the Hobgoblin in public. John used a parade being held in celebration of the recently-announced Hobgoblin Day as the opportunity to murder Kingsley. However, Kingsley had anticipated Myer's betrayal, and when he delivered the fatal blow, Missile Mate had merely hit a holographic decoy. After being confronted for his betrayal, the Goblin King and Goblin Nation attacked the parade. Even though Urich was bested in combat by Kingsley, Myers attempted to get away with him by using some bombs planted into Hobgoblin's Hob-Heroes as leverage. As the Hob-Heroes had been replaced by holograms during the fight, Kingsley "killed" with Pumpkin Bombs so to eliminate Myer's need for the detonator and let the authorities successfully apprehend him and Urich.

john ostrum.origin: Johnny Ostrum came of age in South Carolina in the late 1950s. Ohm's family was so poor they could not even afford electricity. Bitter and ashamed of his lower class roots, Johnny had an instant distrust for others. A true loner and rebel, he could barely contain his rage and was constantly on the lookout for trouble. He spent his life running afoul of the law - finally crossing the line from petty criminal to murderer at the age of 24. During a brutal bar room brawl in Louisiana, two men died and two police officers were sent to the hospital. Johnny was found on the scene intoxicated and unconscious; as a result he was tossed in jail and a guilty verdict was quickly established. Johnny stubbornly claimed his innocence but was never believed. Johnny was labeled a threat to society with no remorse for his hideous crime - and sentenced to death by electrocution. fields.history: Johnny Ostrum came of age in South Carolina in the late 1950s. Ohm's family was so poor they could not even afford electricity. fields.notes: Johnny Ohm (John Ostrum) is a fictional character created by Electronic Arts, in conjunction with Marvel Comics, in their first attempt to bring Marvel heroes to a video game platform, Marvel Nemesis: Rise of the Imperfects. Interestingly, he is the only character to not be described in the game manual. The ohm is a unit of electrical impedance or electrical resistance. Both his name "John Ostrum" and appearance are seemingly inspired by , real name Jon Osterman, from Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons' "Watchmen" graphic novel. During the imperfect invasion of New York, Johnny encountered and fought against Daredevil. He was beaten severely, but his loss was later avenged by Solara. He made amends to Van Roekel by beating Spider-Man in a fight on top of the Daily Bugle. No other material has been developed for Johnny Ohm or the rest of the Imperfects since the release of Marvel Nemesis: Rise of the Imperfects.

john parker.name: John Parker
john parker.origin: The Angel arrives for a party celebrating the release of the newest book written by his friend John Parker. After being welcomed in by the butler, the Angel happens past a room where John Parker is having an argument with Jeff Van over Jeff's relationship with his daughter Alice. John refuses to allow Jeff to see Alice, but Jeff insists that they will be married someday if he likes it or not. Later on that evening as the party goers are proposing a toast to John, he suddenly keels over and dies, much to everyone's surprise. After the party is cleared out, the Angel asks John's friend Harvey who might be likely to kill John. Harvey tells him that Jeff Van is likely, as John and Jeff did not see eye to eye, as Jeff was a medical student and John figured Jeff was only interested in his daughter for the money to finish his education. Going to the coroner, the Angel learns that John was poisoned with strychnine.

john peters.name: John Peters
john peters.origin: A scientist named Zarpo has invented a bomb that will explode when near a human body for more than five minutes. Thinking that this would be a benefit to the United States government, Zarpo brings his invention to government employee John Peters. Peters dismisses Zarpo as a crackpot inventor and kicks him out. Maddened by this rejection, Zarpo gathers a gang for the purpose of eliminating government officials with his bombs. He plants one in the home of Peters, and after Peters ends a visit from his friend Larry Scott he is caught in its explosion. Hearing the blast, Scott changes into Father Time to investigate. Finding Peters dead and no clues as to who has done it, Father Time vows to avenge his friend's death.

john plantagenet.name: John Plantagenet
john plantagenet.origin: ===Early Life=== Prince John was born in England in the 12th century, the youngest son of Henry II. Prince John sought to rebel against the royal administrators of his brother, King Richard the Lionheart, while Richard was away on the Third Crusade. ===The Defenders=== Prince John encountered the Defenders when they were suddenly thrust back to the 12th Century during the Crusades. Aiding the Black Knight against an Arab army, the Defenders faced the formidable Temax. Doctor Strange intervened, rescuing them. The Black Knight, possessing his ancestor's body, exposed Prince John's plot to abandon King Richard. Sworn to thwart Mordred, the Defenders pledged to save the captive king. Disguised, they infiltrated the Arab castle, battling giant gnomes with elemental powers. Simultaneously, Dr. Strange, Hulk, and Namor clashed with Prince John, Mordred, and Chandu. Namor discovered the Gnomes' weakness to water, turning the tide. In the midst of conflict, Prince John seized the Evil Eye from Dr. Strange. Prester John emerged, seizing the device and defeating Prince John and Mordred. As the Black Knight stayed in the Crusades, Prester John transported the Defenders back to their time. ===Robin Hood=== He became the enemy of Robert Locksley, Early Huntingdon better known as the legendary Robin Hood. He was a favorite of his brother and with his allies the Sheriff of Nottingham plotted his downfall. After they returning to England from the Crusades Robin was poisoned by a maid thinking it was medicine, thus ending the life of one of England's greatest heroes. ===Ascension to the Throne=== Upon the death of his brother Richard in 1199 AD, John was declared the king. The baronial revolt at the end of King John's reign led to the sealing of Magna Carta at Parliament, a document considered an early step in the evolution of the constitution of Britain. The immortal Ulysses Bloodstone was present to witness this

john polk.first_appearance: Avengers Assemble Featuring Captain Citrus Vol 1 1
john polk.origin: Polk was walking through his family's orange groves with his sister when seed-like objects fell from the sky in a lightning bolt of energy. A storm began tearing apart their family's house when he bonded with the pods and saved his family. The storm had actually been manufactured by Blizzard under orders from his boss Justin Hammer, and once Polk fought him off, his sister named him Captain Citrus. He later helped the Avengers defeat Leader near his family's property, which prompted Widow to find out more about his background. Later on, Polk attended a summit at the United Nations Headquarters on pediatric nutrition as a speaker when Kang the Conqueror attempted an assassination attempt on the UN. Teaming up yet again with the Avengers, he helped them to defeat Kang without casualties.

john rand.name: John Rand
john rand.origin: John Rand was father of Ka-Zar (David Rand). He was of British origin and owner of a rich diamond fields located in Transvaal, South Africa, and had a wife Constance. In 1921, when flying with his family from Johannesburg to Cairo, their plane crashed in the Belgian Congo. They were stranded in the jungle and while attempting to signal rescue planes John also protected his son David from the dangers of the jungle. Eventually, the rescue planes stopped passing by and Constance died of jungle fever. Deciding it would be best to try and make it to civilization on foot, John attempted to lead the young David out of the jungle. However, the two were caught in a storm and John suffered a blow to the head which made him think that the jungle was their home. He raised his son to survive in the jungle and educated him in reading and writing. The two lived together in the jungle, and years later they came across Paul de Kraft, a man searching for jewels in the region. Seeing de Kraft's presence as an intrusion, John confronted him and demanded his departure from the jungle. While David was off inspecting the wonders of Paul de Kraft's Camp, de Kraft and his minions found the house that he shared with his father John. There they mortally wounded John, and when David came back home he was threatened by Paul de Kraft. John died after David was rescued by the lion Zar, who frightened the killer away. Although John died, his son was adopted by Zar the lion and became known as the legendary hero Ka-Zar.

john rayburn actor.name: John Rayburn (Actor)
john rayburn actor.origin: A man reads in the newspaper that V.T.C. Pictures is going to begin reshooting the film "South Sea Paradise" and vows to prevent the production from completing. Not far away on a Pacific Island, Director Spade begins preparations for the next days shooting and has one of his crew set up a camera set up in one of the massive palm trees. Witnessing this, the mystery man sneaks onto the set at night and cuts through the tree so that it topples the next morning. The next day, the Sub-Mariner is racing with fish when he happens upon the movie set and decides to take a look around. During the filming a stunt double is sent to climb up the palm tree, but it suddenly topples killing the actor. Namor officers his assistance and upon examination of the tree he finds evidence showing that it was deliberately cut and promises to find the person responsible. Soon the next swimming scene involving the primary actor is to be shot next. When the actor dives into the water, he is followed by what appears to be a shark. However, it is the killer wearing a realistic shark-costume and he stabs the actor fatally. Witnessing this "shark attack", Namor arrives too late to save the actor, and the shark surprisingly manages to fight the hero off and disappear. Examining the dead actors body, the Sub-Mariner deduces that the man was not killed by a real shark, but really stabbed to death. Searching the island, Namor finds footprints that lead to a mountain on the island. There he begins to feel weak from a lack of water and is easily captured by the killer, who locks him up in a room in his private cabin. Planning to kill the lead actress of the film, the killer reveals himself as John Rayburn, an actor who played in the original version of "South Pacific Paradise" until he was maimed in a shark attack. He then mocks the Sub-Mariner by leaving a bucket of water outside of the window of his prison knowing the hero is too weak to break free and will eventually die. However, Namor manages to free himself by tying the bed sheets to a pillow and using it as a sponge to bring the water to him and revitalize his strength. Namor arrives at he scene before Rayburn can attack the starlet in his shark costume. Easily defeating Rayburn, the Sub-Mariner turns him over to the crew to hand over to the authorities. When the Director offers Namor a role in a film, he politely declines and returns to the ocean.

john reynolds.name: John Reynolds
john reynolds.origin: John Reynolds and his partner Agent Bradley were triple agents; they worked for S.H.I.E.L.D., reported to Hydra, and additionally sold the secrets of both organizations on the dark web. An undercover mission on behalf of S.H.I.E.L.D. inside a Hydra offshore rig went awry when Hydra was tipped off of Reynolds and Bradley's supposed true allegiance, leading to the two agents being captured and tortured. Young agent Maria Hill was sent to their rescue. While taking cover from enemy fire, Reynolds demanded Hill gave him her gun as her senior agent in order to take over the mission. Under S.H.I.E.L.D.'s rules, Hill decided to relieve Reynolds, seeing him mentally unfit to take command. Commander Reynolds insisted, becoming increasingly hostile towards Hill, to the point she had to strike him to defend herself when Reynolds tried to forcefully take her weapon twice. In retaliation, Reynolds lunged at Hill. This last act left his head exposed to enemy fire, which cost Reynolds his life. In the aftermath, Agent Bradley accused Hill of field misconduct. She was brought to a tribunal, but was found innocent. S.H.I.E.L.D. would subsequently learn of Reynold and Bradley's operations as triple agents.

john rival.name: John Rival
john rival.origin: When Alex Power had his first day of school after moving to New York, he immediately had a conflict with Johnny Rival. Johnny had a habit of stirring up Alex's insecurities. Also, Johnny had an interest in Allison McCourt but Allison clearly preferred Alex over Johnny. At one time, Johnny became convinced that Alex was a mutant. Johnny acquired a gun and was going to turn Alex in to the authorities but instead, Johnny and Alex got entangled in a fight between Spiderman and the Hobgoblin. After that Johnny and Alex were friends until later when Alex prevented Johnny from being gunned down by the police along with Johnny's brother Raphael. Despite saving Johnny's life, Johnny thought Alex had prevented Johnny from saving Raphael's life. Johnny still holds bitterness toward Alex about this.

john robert keane.origin: Tumbler was a noted acrobatic criminal who had encounters with Captain America on more than one occasion. He was hired by The Secret Empire to battle Captain America but was murdered by Moonstone, who was also working for the Secret Empire and managed to pin his death on Rogers. His brother, Michael Keane, later assumed the mantle of the Tumbler.

john roberts.name: John Roberts
john roberts.origin: John Roberts was a geology professor who lived on his own plantation in Florida with his nephew Tim. Professor Roberts worked closely with adventurer Ken Masters. He was also a neighbor of John Crafton. In the summer of 1939, Professor Roberts was exploring the Amazon Jungle to seek an indigenous tribe that mined diamonds possessing hypnotic powers. Eventually, he found and was captured by locals. After being missing for three months, Ken Masters and his nephew came to seek the professor, and rescued him from the rainforest. Roberts was able to retrieve one hypnotic diamond from the mine.

john rogers.name: John Rogers
john rogers.origin: Sometime in the future, a planet is surrounded by a strange mist that warns travellers of a quarantine. In the year 2006, Colonel John Rogers arrives back on Earth to an adoring crowd, carrying a sample of vegetation from Nythanos. The plant telepathically tells the crown that it is really Colonel Rogers, and the plant's life-essence has taken possession of his body. He now has the plant's powers, but they only work in Nythanos' atmosphere. To test the claim, the atmosphere of Nythanos is duplicated, and John Rogers is able to retake control of his body. The plant explains that it had John Rogers' memories, and didn't realize it wasn't really him. It warns that there are many other plants on Nythanos who will use such an ability instinctively. The planet is quarantined, and the plant returned home.
